text:
maria: Heads-up — we got a customer report that FP8 pilot produced subtle hallucination/formatting regressions on a handful of long-context prompts. Can we sketch a rollback/safety checklist?

sam: Yikes. First pass: shadow-compare + per-route canary + auto-rollback triggers.

lee: Agree. Shadow-compare is key — run FP8 in parallel, log full outputs and diffs vs fp16. Keep it out of production path.

sam: Short checklist idea: 
- Shadow run for 24–72h on a representative traffic slice
- Compute embedding cosine + token-level edit distance per-request
- Alert on >X% of requests exceeding delta thresholds
- Canary at 1% -> 5% -> 20% with manual gate at 20%

maria: What should thresholds be? We need concrete numbers for alerts we can tune.

lee: Proposal: embedding_cos_sim < 0.985 OR normalized_edit_distance > 0.03 triggers a warning; >0.05 triggers critical. Keep these per-route and per-model.

sam: Also track downstream signal: conversion or accept-rate drop. Add a rolling-window evaluation (median + 95th pct) so spikes don't cause noise.

tiffany: Add customer-level opt-outs and per-customer shadowing. Some enterprise customers want to opt out of experimental precisions.

sam: We should persist calibration metadata (scale factors, zero points) and quantization-stats per-batch so we can inspect what changed when drift happens. Store histograms: q_error_hist, activation_range_history.

lee: For automation, add a safety policy: if eval-suite aggregate metric drops >1.5% vs baseline on 10k eval prompts, auto-toggle feature-flag off and notify SRE/SE.

maria: What does the feature-flag / kill-switch look like?

sam: Example flag payload: 
```json
{
  "feature": "precision_fp8",
  "routes": ["text.generate","chat.stream"],
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "shadow_compare": true,
  "auto_rollback_thresholds": {
    "embedding_cos_sim": 0.985,
    "norm_edit_dist": 0.05
  }
}
```

tiffany: Need operational hooks: 
- immediate rollback API for oncall
- rollback dry-run to test switch-over
- postmortem template for precision rollbacks

devex-bot: Quant rollback runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-rollback — includes checklist, runbook steps, and postmortem template.

sam: Also add a "shadow-compare diff exporter" job that writes top-10 diffs to a secure S3 bucket for SE review. Should redact PII.

lee: Important: add sample-weighted metrics for long-tail prompts. FP8 may degrade rare cases disproportionately. Flag if tail metric change > 2x median change.

maria: Ops question — can Dedicated customers pin precision? We should allow per-customer precision pinning so rollouts don't affect committed capacity.

tiffany: Yes — we expose precision config at customer-profile level. We need UI + API + billing note.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: precision_fp8 -> 5% traffic on region us-west-2. (deploy id: dpl-2026-04-12-77)

maria: Action items: 
1) eng-ml: implement shadow-compare exporter + eval thresholds (owner: sam)
2) infra: feature-flag kill-switch + per-customer pinning (owner: tiffany)
3) devex: update runbook and docs (owner: devex-bot)
4) oncall: add auto-rollback alert escalation (owner: lee)

sam: I'll open a PR with the exporter + thresholds today.

lee: I'll draft the auto-rollback SLOs and the alert rules.

tiffany: I'll add API changes to the customer-profile RFC draft.

maria: Thanks. Once PRs land let's run a 72h shadow on the known failing prompt set and iterate. :thumbsup:
